content: EthIf shall delay the shutdown of an EthIfPhysController referencing a EthIfSwitch until all EthSwtPorts of the referenced switch are in state ETH _MODE_DOW N.
OBSOLETE EthIf shall delay the shutdown of an EthIfPhysController referencing a EthIfSwitch until all EthSwtPorts of the referenced switch are in state ETH _MODE_DOWN.
